item.title: GE Healthcare: Centricity PACS Server V7, intended for managing digital medical images and associated data, All versions Recall
item.product: Centricity PACS Server V7, intended for managing digital medical images and associated data, All versions
item.summary: Under certain conditions historical imaging data migrated from a legacy system may become incorrectly associated with a different patient. If this occurs, studies or images may be displayed under the wrong patient record, which could lead to misdiagnosis or a delay in patient care. Product details: Centricity PACS Server V7, intended for managing digital medical images and associated data, All versions
